ana: Heads-up — main CI is red on latest commit b3f9d2. Typecheck + formatting failures. Build: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/1936012345 :grimacing:
ci-bot: Build #1936012345 failed · step `typecheck` exit 1 · step `pre-commit` exit 1. Failing areas: pyright errors in python/sdk/, rustfmt diffs in crates/kvcache/src/lib.rs, pre-commit hooks modified files. Logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/1936012345/logs
jordan: On it, i'll try a focused rerun for typecheck + pre-commit.
nana (ana typo fix): sorry, ignore that last line :facepalm: (meant to say thanks jordon)
nana (ana correction): (deleted)
nana (ana correction 2): (deleted)
nana: ignore previous noise — typo on my end.
nana: actual error snippet from pyright:
```
/py/sdk/client.py:142: error: Argument of type "Literal['embed']" cannot be assigned to parameter "mode" of type "GenerationMode" in function "create_job"
  "embed"
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 112 source files)
```
jordan: That looks like the new pyright strictness from the stub bump. I merged the mypy/pyright bump yesterday — could be the culprit.
kevin: I can take the rustfmt bit. Locally `cargo fmt --all -- --check` shows a single diff in crates/kvcache/src/lib.rs (trailing comma + wrapped match arm). I'll push a small formatting commit to a branch.
sam: @jordan did that pyright bump land on main or only in the feature branch?
jordan: landed on main around 11:30pm PT yesterday. I can revert if rerun still fails.
jordan: @ci-bot can you rerun only the typecheck and pre-commit jobs for build 1936012345? :pray:
ci-bot: Manual rerun requested by jordan. Jobs queued: typecheck, pre-commit. ETA ~2m — https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/1936012345/rerun
maria: If pre-commit is failing it might be the black upgrade (we bumped black in dev-deps). Pre-commit pins might be loose. We should pin in .pre-commit-config.yaml if this is causing flakes.
kevin: Pushed branch `fmt/fix-kvcache` with one commit: https://git.internal.redwood/kevin/fmt/commit/7b1a. Do not merge yet, will wait for rerun.
ci-bot: Rerun complete · typecheck: ✅ passed · pre-commit: ❌ failed · rustfmt: ❌ (diffs detected in crates/kvcache/src/lib.rs) · details: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/1936012345/rerun/results
ana (ana): Ok — typecheck passed after rerun (so pyright bump itself isn't breaking everyone), but pre-commit still fails due to rustfmt and black differences.
sam: Looks like two independent issues: rustfmt in kvcache (kevin's branch should fix) and black version change affecting python formatting.
maria: Quick mitigation: pin black to 23.9 in pre-commit, open follow-up to graduate to 24.x once we update codebase. I'll open a PR to pin.
jordan: Plan: merge kevin's formatting commit (once CI green), merge maria's pin for black, and then open a follow-up to revert the strict pyright settings if we see more flaps. If rerun still red after merges, i'll bisect main~1..HEAD.
nana (ana): I'll assemble the PRs and do the merges once the green runs come back. Thanks everyone. :tada:
kevin: Thx — I kicked off a new CI run on my branch, will report back in ~5m.
ci-bot: Branch run queued: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/1936012501 (kevin/fmt/fix-kvcache)
nana (ana): If anything else pops up, please ping here.
ci-bot: Branch build #1936012501: success ✅. Recommend merging kevin/fmt/fix-kvcache.
jordan: Merged kevin's commit and maria's black-pin PR. Re-running main CI now.
ci-bot: Main build #1936012520: success ✅ · all checks passed.
nana (ana): Great — closing out. We'll open a small retro ticket to track pyright strictness stability and consider adding a pre-merge typecheck smoke job.
maria: Added ticket INFRA-412 in backlog.
sam: Nice triage, nice quick fixes. :thumbsup:
